decided: A chain setting written wrongly is read quietly, with no warning printed: an entry whose value is not true grants nothing while the other entries still grant, an entry orbit does not know is ignored, and a setting that is not a list of entries at all grants nothing.
alternatives: print a warning naming the wrong entry each time the change status is read, as orbit's size ceiling and review preference settings do
why: A wrong entry falls back to today's behaviour for that command, where the user runs the step themselves, so nothing unsafe follows from it; and the status the workflows read at every step should stay free of repeated warnings.
detail: resolveChainSetting in src/core/project-config.ts returns configured:false for an absent or non-map value and grants a key only when its value is the boolean true; unlike resolveSizeCeiling and resolveReviewPreference it never calls console.warn.
